subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw keep this umbrella and split it into native batching, context lifecycle, and plan-enforcement design tracks, and which parts belong in core versus plugin or ClawHub extension surfaces?
rationale: The requested work adds native tool schemas, local context lifecycle semantics, persisted/session state behavior, new config/settings, and runner enforcement policy, which repository policy treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Narrow Trackers
options.body: Make the context and workflow issues canonical for their portions and open or request a separate batch-tools tracker if maintainers want that work independently.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the umbrella if maintainers decide context-block and plan-enforcement semantics are too much heavy orchestration for OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across planning, strict-agentic execution, web search, and context pruning.
